guard: a partial ps poll keeps a silent manager's seats, replaces an answering manager's rows wholesale, drops a manager that is neither, and never applies two reads out of order
why: The suite imports control.ts from src through tsx, so a mutation is seen without a build and needs no rebuild after the restore.
Each mutation is compile-clean and its anchor occurs exactly once in the named file.

mutations.name: M1 a silent manager's seats are dropped instead of kept
mutations.expectRed: ...while the SILENT manager's seat is kept
mutations.cell: ...while the SILENT manager's seat is kept
mutations.note: A manager that simply did not answer this tick would have its seats vanish from the console, which is the failure the partial-poll fold exists to prevent.

mutations.name: M2 an answering manager's rows are merged rather than replaced
mutations.find: for (const a of reply.answered) next.set(a.instanceId, a.rows);
mutations.expectRed: A's rows keep being replaced across repeated partial polls
mutations.cell: A's rows keep being replaced across repeated partial polls
mutations.note: Merging pins stale rows forever: a despawned seat never leaves the list.

mutations.name: M3 a reachable manager failure is retained as if it were silent
mutations.expectRed: a reachable manager error drops its previous rows instead of retaining them as silent
mutations.cell: a reachable manager error drops its previous rows instead of retaining them as silent
mutations.note: Treating a reachable error as silence retains stale launch facts even though that manager did answer and rejected the read.

mutations.name: M4 a prior silence suppresses the later manager error notice
mutations.expectRed: ...and a later reachable error replaces the silence notice
mutations.cell: ...and a later reachable error replaces the silence notice
mutations.note: Announce-once must key on the partial state, not on whether any partial was announced before, or a new reachable failure stays hidden behind an older silence warning.
